points.description: Gives the complete correct set of possible values of b−a: 11, 100 and 110 (e.g. 19991→20002 gives 11; 10001→10101 gives 100; 10901→11011 gives 110), with every step of the reasoning valid. Any wrong step, a missing or extra value, or a wrong final answer earns 0.

rubric.notes: Full mark only for the answer 11, 100, 110 with valid reasoning throughout. Any error in a step or an incorrect or incomplete set of values earns no marks. No partial credit.
rubric.answer_key: Write a palindrome as abcba = 10001a + 1010b + 100c. The next palindrome is found by increasing the middle digit c by 1 (difference 100). If c = 9 and b < 9, it becomes b+1 with c = 0 (difference 1010 − 900 = 110). If b = c = 9 and a < 9, it becomes (a+1)0 0 0(a+1) (difference 10001 − 9090 − 900 = 11). Possible values of b−a: 11, 100, 110.
